description: Find Befana recipes by keywords, time, diet tags, and ingredients on hand or to avoid. Signed in, the cook's saved allergies, diet and avoid list already apply; signed out it works too, over public recipes only (mine needs sign-in). Returns short summaries with slugs; call get_recipe for the full recipe. Tags in use include vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, quick, dinner, breakfast, dessert, baking, soup, side, snack, make-ahead. Signed in, the cook's own recipes and versions come first; mine: true returns only those ("show me my chili"), private ones included. When the cook names a recipe their allergies, diet or avoid list hide, it comes back in hidden (slug, url, title, why) instead of recipes. They asked for it, so don't stop to ask: go on with what they asked (get_recipe, get_cook_steps, get_recipe with substitute, build_shopping_list) with that slug; the result leads with the warning, and you tell the cook why it was hidden before anything else. Never present a hidden recipe as safe.

exclude_ingredients.description: Extra ingredients to avoid for this search (saved allergies and dislikes already apply)

from_pantry.description: Rank by what the cook has in their saved pantry ("something with pasta from what I have"); each result says what they have and what's missing. For a pure "what can I make?" use suggest_from_pantry

include_ingredients.description: Ingredients the recipe must use, e.g. what is in the fridge

mine.description: Only the cook's own recipes and versions, including private ones

name: search_recipes
title: Search recipes
